subject: ventures/changepoint-detector
professional: an applied statistician / econometrician who runs changepoint and policy-evaluation analyses (R changepoint, ruptures, segmented regression for interrupted time series, the Synth package) on business and public series; first checks: does PELT give the exact optimal segmentation for the stated cost and penalty (and agree with ruptures on fresh data), does the synthetic control reproduce Abadie, Diamond and Hainmueller's Prop 99 result, are the interrupted-time-series coefficients and F the textbook Prais-Winsten ones, and are false-positive rates and limits stated

evidence.correctness: Seven recomputes against sources the author did not write, all pass. (1) Nile mean model, own O(n^2) DP (scratchpad changepoint-detector/dp1.py): sigma 115.319, penalty 9.2103, change at 28 (1899), means 1097.75/849.972 = `node cli.mjs --example --json --no-agreed` exactly (Cobb 1978 date). (2) Coal-mining Poisson, same DP: changes 41 (1892) and 97 (1948), penalty 9.437 = engine. (3) Fresh ruptures cross-check: installed ruptures 1.1.10 (numpy 2.5.3) and drew 100 NEW seeded cases (seed 4121, mean and meanvar, four penalties; scratchpad rpt_fresh.py); engine pelt() equals ruptures Pelt on 100 of 100. The committed fixture also replays: ruptures today returns the stored answers on 100 of 100 (closes the 11-09 audit's 'not re-run' caveat). (4) Synthetic control, new since 11-09: own simplex-constrained least squares (FISTA + Duchi projection, scratchpad synth.py) on CA vs 38 donors 1970-88: weights UT 0.391, MT 0.229, NV 0.207, CT 0.109, NH 0.043, CO 0.021 (engine UT .391 MT .227 NV .207 CT .109 NH .043 CO .024); pre-RMSPE 1.66, gap -19.5 average and -26.5 at 2000, floor 2.15, floored rank 1 p 0.026, plain ratio rank 3 p 0.077, 32% donors fit better: identical to the CLI. Abadie et al. 2010 report about -26 packs by 2000. (5) Known-date test, new: own iterated Prais-Winsten segmented regression (Wagner et al. 2002; scratchpad its.py) on Nile at 1899: rho 0.1500, step -289.44 se 66.09, slope 1.1628, slope change -0.4908 se 3.5332, Wald F 14.827 = engine JSON to every printed digit; scipy f.sf(14.827,2,96) = 2.4465e-6 = engine pTable. (6) Joint multi-column PELT, new: own DP (mdp.py) on a seeded 2-column series: sigmas 1.2453/1.7817, penalty 3 ln 120 = 14.3625, changes [50, 85], cost 244.8767 = multiPelt and `cli.mjs --columns a,b --json`. Not 4: BOCPD probabilities, the drift (DeCAFS-type) model, the update-rate/stale-feed likelihoods and the watch NB cost were not recomputed independently.
evidence.completeness: Walked: CLI default, --json, --example, --model poisson, --known-date (text and JSON, placebos printed), --donors with --covariates and --window (Prop 99 command from the README prints exactly the recorded numbers in 2.7 s), --columns (agreed and joint panels), --help (all options listed). Served copy (`node platform/pages/served-copy.mjs changepoint-detector`): no placeholder origins; headless Chrome load of the served page: renders 'When did your series change?', no uncaught errors (I did not click through each box). Stripe and Shopify sources exist with mocked tests (cannot run without accounts); watch.mjs, deploy/make-watch-repo.sh, agent entry exist. Every negative result in the README is labelled 'not offered' and the corresponding option is absent from --help, so no stubs presented as features. No TODO/FIXME found in the shipped modules.
evidence.verification: `node --test '*.test.mjs'` in the venture: 1026 tests, 1026 pass, 0 fail, 5 m 21 s wall (was 343 tests in 8 m 44 s on 11-09). Five seeded mutants via quality_mutate.py: floored placebo ratio reverted to the plain ratio (synth-control.mjs:308) CAUGHT, 7 of 22 failed; known-date step indicator t>=k -> t>k (known-date.mjs:89) CAUGHT; multi-column BIC parameter count (multivariate.mjs:39) CAUGHT; Shopify cancelled orders also counted as orders (shopify-metrics.mjs:146) CAUGHT; and the 11-09 audit's defect re-checked: default BIC constant 2 ln n -> 1.5 ln n (engine.mjs:1607) CAUGHT, 14 of 102 tests failed (on 11-09 the same mutant failed 1 of 7 targeted tests and a full engine.test.mjs run exceeded 280 s; it now runs in 40 s), so that medium defect is closed in effect, though there is still no direct pin of penaltyValue('bic', n, 'mean') = 2 ln n. Tests include brute-force optimal partitioning, ruptures fixtures, closed-form evidence for BOCPD, the Prop 99 CLI numbers and seeded size/power rates.
evidence.craft: Read engine.mjs (now 3004 lines, up from 2243; analyze() at :2154), multivariate.mjs, known-date.mjs, synth-control.mjs (fit and placebo code), shopify-metrics.mjs, cli.mjs (301). The new modules are clean, small and separately tested, and the page runs heavy work in workers. Defects: engine.mjs grew 34% since the audit that flagged it as a monolith; 225 test files and ~60 modules sit flat in the venture root with no test directory; helpers are copied rather than shared (mulberry PRNG in 3 modules, lag1 in 3, median in 3, a private Gauss-Jordan invert/ols in known-date.mjs); llms.txt carries single lines of 5,000+ characters of research history; shopify-metrics uses a fixed --utc-offset, so daily buckets shift an hour across DST.
evidence.claims: Checked: ruptures 100/100 (re-run, holds, plus 100/100 fresh); Poisson cross-check fixture present; Nile and coal results (reproduced); Prop 99 'UT 0.391, MT 0.227, NV 0.207; gap -19.5 on average, -26.5 at 2000; rank 1 of 39, p 0.026 (ratio: 3rd)' (reproduced independently); known-date size '1.0-5.8%' points to eval/known-date-sim-round5.out.txt (present, not re-run); CLI prints a power caveat with each synthetic control ('a large p is not evidence of no effect') and the fit/covariate warnings; page and README carry the not-advice disclaimer, no-upload privacy note, local-only usage counts with opt-out, MIT and independence lines; VENTURE.yaml stage prototype, hypotheses untested. Stale: README Verification says '581 tests on 2026-11-12'; the suite has 1026 (and the 11-09 '321' is gone). R changepoint still honestly declared unchecked.
evidence.fitness: Jobs walked: (a) 'did this series shift and when' on Nile: one command, dates, means, range and probability; (b) 'did California's sales fall after the 1989 tax, against states that did not tax' : one command with --donors gives the gap, weights, placebo p, balance table and the power caveat, and the page has the same with a one-click example; (c) 'did the level/slope change at a date I name': --known-date gives step, slope change, ranges, bootstrap p and in-time placebos. A practitioner could finish all three. The gap from 11-09 widened, not closed: the option list is ~45 flags and the README (8,396 lines) and llms.txt are research logs, so a newcomer must know which flag fits; the page's guided boxes mitigate this.
evidence.domain: Compared with Killick et al. 2012 (PELT, exact vs ruptures), Abadie, Diamond and Hainmueller 2010 (outcome-only V, placebo-in-space ranks; the floored ratio is a documented, pre-registered departure from the paper's RMSPE ratio that keeps exchangeability because the floor is computed symmetrically over all units), Wagner et al. 2002 / Bernal et al. 2017 segmented regression with Prais-Winsten AR(1) and a parametric bootstrap instead of the F table (a sound small-sample choice; the refusal near a unit root is what a careful econometrician would do). Departures a statistician would flag are stated: covariates only as a balance diagnostic (no V-weighting on covariates, after two failed rounds), low power on real tax rises (MA/AZ/OR ranked 6-13), AR(1) only, mean-model sigma fixed from differences. No inference on the number of changes beyond the penalty.

verdict: Re-audit of a flagship that has roughly tripled since 11-09 (343 to 1026 tests; synthetic control, known-date ITS, multi-column joint PELT, drift model, update-rate checks, a watch with Stripe/Shopify sources). Six independent recomputes match the engine exactly, including the two biggest new features: my own simplex least-squares synthetic control reproduces the Prop 99 weights, gap (-26.5 packs at 2000, as in Abadie et al. 2010) and floored placebo rank 1 of 39, and my own Prais-Winsten segmented regression reproduces the known-date step, slope change and F to every digit. With ruptures now installed, 100 fresh seeded cases agree 100 of 100 and the committed fixture replays 100 of 100, closing the 11-09 caveat. All 1026 tests pass in 5 m 21 s and five seeded mutants were all caught, including the 11-09 BIC-constant mutant that then failed only one test (now 14). It meets the bar (correctness, claims, verification 3; median 3) and is finished. Still open from 11-09 and worse: craft (engine.mjs 2,243 to 3,004 lines, copied helpers, 225 flat test files) and the README/llms.txt as research logs (8,396 lines; a 5,000-character llms.txt line); the README test count is stale again (581 vs 1026). Closed: the thin BIC guard (in effect), the 9-minute suite (now 5 min), the ruptures claim not re-run.
